full_page.content:
1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 331 Cont.
Apr. 12 Wm. Laney - 49 - cancer on foot 10 mo's has wife and three boys. ... Dr's want to operate to-night. Advised to wait till Monday ... and go after PP. Souls. also gave her - his wife relic of Fr. Stephen.
14 Ross Simpson - 34 - drinks - boisterous - beats wife etc ... Ceclia Fradette - 28 - losing mind feared .... John Mac Donald - 68 - San Francisco - serious operation. Blank Page
Page 332 Page 333
Apr. 15 Edw'd Repp - 41 - eczema - fearful at times driving almost insane; has been doctring near three yrs. No help. Seems just now to be coming bad again.
16 Mrs. Mary McQillan - 70 - gall-stones & Heart and liver .... Gov. Gen. Murphy ..... lonl.
Harry Socha - 22 - Very stiff arm when on Febr. 26 last was enrol- led in Ser. Mass Assoc'n. To-day quite O.K. & working-Deo Gr.
Mrs. M. Lilly - 35 - Enemic nervous - Enrolled April 10 (a week to- morrow) is quite O.K. Deo Gr. - Keeps promise to enroll perpetually.
17 Mrs. M. Trump - 56 - treating for something like cancer of breast .... fears operation. Enrolled some weeks ago. - To-day Fid+is
Mrs. Marie Jamischefski - lutherin - 53 - inward groth. Mrs. Wolff ... going back to Ely, Minn.
Blank Page
Page 334 Page 335 Apr. 17 Mrs. M. Kliemann - trying to sell Janet J. Donnelly - 2'2 - of Muskegan
Jerome Hughes - 56 - threatened with eyes - fears blindness. John Doyle - 40 - in Soldier Home Hosp., Milwaykee - T. B. Prayers asked if God - will he recover soon.
